name: Beacon Transit Resolver
author: QUILL Team
description: Contributes a fallback location resolver to Quill Beacon, matching a saved quote against current content when the built-in locators fail. Sample of the beacon.resolver capability.

location_resolvers.description: A last-ditch case-insensitive quote search; returns a low-confidence match (needs review) when the exact locators could not place the location.
